name: Facet Lightrim
description: Hold plate and blade as the two courts of a single guard each covering what the other leaves open.

name: Evergreen Edgeplate
description: Rap with the plate at the instant the blade moves so that parry and cut arrive as one.

name: Dab Vortex
description: Trade the lead foot as plate and blade trade the lead so the front never stays still.

name: Umbospine
description: Pass qi back and forth between plate arm and sword arm so whichever is struck is the stronger.

name: Blaze Snapblock
description: Cross the plate and blade over the foe's guard with qi in both to strike two points at once.

name: Ponderous Armstrap
description: Bind the foe's weapon between the plate rim and the flat of the blade and hold it there.

name: Invincible Punchboss
description: Advance behind a screen of paired qi from plate and blade that covers the holder and one companion.

name: Glamour Centergrip
description: Catch a heavy blow on the plate and return it through the blade in the same stroke.

name: Dazzling Rumble Nudge
description: Vanish from before the foe's blow and reappear at his flank with plate and blade already crossing his line.

name: Invincible Roundface
description: Hold the plate high and steady like a hawk hovering on the wind and watch for the opening.

name: Shattering Umbo
description: Fall on the foe's guard from above with the rim in a swift narrow cut.

name: Gust Smallface
description: Slide aside from a thrust with the eyes still fixed on the foe's hand.

name: Bucklerredge Nerve
description: Turn the plate edge-on like a pinion cutting the air so the blade is brushed away.

name: Tempered Punchblock
description: Rap the foe's wrist twice before he can complete a draw.

name: Granite Lightrim
description: Lift the plate on a rising breath of qi so cuts from below are carried over the head.

name: Thorn Bucklerredge
description: Close the rim on the foe's blade like a talon and pull it from his hand.

name: Tuckin Havoc
description: Dive in with the dome leading and a stoop of qi that drives it through the guard.

name: Facetumbo
description: Throw the plate's shadow of qi over an ally beside the holder so blows meant for him glance off.

name: Mightpelta
description: Strike the foe's hand with the rim and the dome in the same instant as he lunges.

name: Nova Roundface
description: Fold from sight in a stoop and strike from above and behind the foe's guard before he can turn.

name: Evergreen Umbo
description: Keep one track of the guard fixed on the plate and leave the other track free for the strike.

name: Granite Knucklegrip
description: Send the strike along its own track with the dome while the guard track stays closed.

name: Might Parry
description: Switch from guard footwork to strike footwork in a single stride.

name: Torrent Edgeplate
description: Rap a cut at the seam where the two tracks meet so the blade finds neither.

name: Thorn Punchboss
description: Draw qi in two parallel lines through the arm so guard and strike never starve each other.

name: Blaze Nudge
description: Merge the two tracks at the dome so one punch carries both streams of qi.

name: Chime Knucklegrip
description: Cross the plate over the foe's blade on the guard track and clear it for the strike track.

name: Granite Punchblock
description: Bring both tracks together in the rim and cut through a guard at the point of meeting.

name: Aegistarge
description: Join both tracks across the plate as a single screen of doubled qi against a barrage.

name: Escalating Smallface
description: Run guard and strike tracks in one unbroken chain of parry and bind and punch that leaves the foe no gap.

name: Impervious Armstrap
description: Settle into a stance deep and wide as a basin floor with the plate canted to catch.

name: Ghosting Dab
description: Walk forward without ripple so the plate is never jolted off its set angle.

name: Murk Edgeplate
description: Rap a blade down into the lower rim so its force drains toward the ground.

name: Nudgeruin
description: Sweep the rim low across the foe's shins from behind the basin stance.

name: Iron Punchboss
description: Hold the plate unmoving until the foe's flurry settles and his rhythm slackens.

name: Peltadurance
description: Draw qi low into the plate until it is deep enough to swallow a heavy chop.

name: Chimetarge
description: Rap a full basin's worth of stored force into the foe's blade to hurl it aside.

name: Targespine
description: Hook the rim under the foe's guard and pull against him as an undertow drags a wader.

name: Tempered Centergrip
description: Tilt the pooled qi out of the plate into a heavy overhand strike of the rim.

name: Unassailable Smallface
description: Lay a calm screen of qi that stops every blow aimed at the holder's front without a ripple.

name: Punishing Parry
description: Let the full basin spill outward in a flat sweep that throws back foes on every side.

name: Hourdab
description: Press the plate down on the foe's weapon with the whole pooled weight of qi until his arm sinks under it.

name: Hoarfrost Roundface
description: Hold the plate with a hawk's alert height and a river's easy flow in the arm.

name: Blinding Snapblock
description: Glide sideways along the foe's blade the way a river skirts a rock.

name: Lightrim Hardihood
description: Rap down from above on the foe's blade as a hawk drops on its prey.

name: Granite Centergrip
description: Slash the rim along the foe's arm in one long unbroken stroke.

name: Obdurate Umbo
description: Fold the arm in behind the plate to close the guard the moment a cut comes.

name: Unbudging Knucklegrip
description: Lift a cut on the current of qi in the plate and set it down far from the body.

name: Vengeful Dab
description: Rap the blade away on the river's flow and drop the hawk-quick dome onto the opened guard.

name: Ponderous Bucklerredge
description: Clamp the rim over the foe's blade like a hawk's grip and carry it down the stream.

name: Unconquered Bucklerredge
description: Hold qi in small eddies around the plate that turn glancing cuts and drag them past.

name: Parryhavoc
description: Send a long wave of qi from the swung rim to strike every foe in its path.

name: Targedurance
description: Take a blow on the plate and turn it back high over the water like a hawk flung from a gust.

name: Irontarge
description: Raise a swollen river's rush of qi before the plate that carries thrusts and blows off to the sides.

name: Phantom Nudge
description: Pass through the foe's line in one flowing flash and return along the far bank with the plate raised.

name: Targevalor
description: Hold the rim edge forward so that blows meet the rim before the face.

name: Peltaglare
description: Move along the line between foe and sky so the plate always shows him a blank edge.

name: Flintlike Edgeplate
description: Rap the foe's blade with a clean quick motion that leaves no echo on the guard.

name: Dabscourge
description: Run bright qi round the rim so that a slash lays open the foe's arm and armor strap.

name: Iron Armstrap
description: Spread qi broad and thin across the plate to cover a wide arc at the shoulder.

name: Punishing Tuckin
description: Let the rim fall in a steep arc from above the head through the foe's raised weapon.

name: Iron Punchblock
description: Gather qi like a darkening sky into the dome and release it in a single crushing punch.

name: Centergrip Durance
description: Hold the plate high and let qi spread over the holder like a dome against blows from every side.

name: Unseen Snapblock
description: Flash through the foe's guard along a bright arc of qi and cut with the rim as the arc closes.

name: Umbonerve
description: Hold the plate before the body in the open court of the river's bank and let the foe come.

name: Dazzling Tuckin
description: Cross the foe's reach in a ford of shallow steps with the plate between you.

name: Chime Smallface
description: Turn the plate like a bank turns water and send the blade down the length of the arm.

name: Rumble Tuckin
description: Rap the foe's knuckles with a small hard flick of the rim.

name: Lightrim Fortitude
description: Bend the whole body beneath a cut like a reed in the current and rise behind the plate.

name: Flintlike Umbo
description: Bind qi into the plate in a steady stream that grows stronger the longer the foe presses.

name: Gyveparry
description: Turn the rim round the foe's blade in a whirl that wrenches the weapon from line.

name: Vengeful Parry
description: Throw the dome forward on the full current of qi in the arm.

name: Facet Knucklegrip
description: Receive a charge on the plate and run its force round the body to leave by the rim into the foe.

name: Tuckinruin
description: Gather the whole weight of the river in the dome and strike once with it.

name: Hour Punchboss
description: Flash from the river's near bank to the far one and take the foe from the side his guard left open.

name: Punchboss Fortitude
description: Plant the feet and hold the plate to the front in the stance in which the oath was sworn.

name: Chime Roundface
description: Meet a cut with the plate turned as a hand is raised against the wind.

name: Headlong Nudge
description: Step into the foe's attack on the beat of the wind so the plate is there before the blade.

name: Gust Punchblock
description: Rap the rim on the foe's guard as a pledge struck down.

name: Umbodurance
description: Hold the guard unbroken by pain or fatigue as a sworn man holds his word.

name: Thorn Dab
description: Bind the blade with a gust of qi through the rim that tightens until the foe lets go.

name: Tempered Nudge
description: Press the dome forward by qi like a sworn charge until the foe's guard breaks.

name: Facetpelta
description: Draw a wide screen of qi from the plate under which the companions at the holder's side stand safe.

name: Unrelenting Edgeplate
description: Turn the force of a foe who strikes against the holder's sworn line back into his own arm.

name: Hour Snapblock
description: Blow past the foe's guard in a flash like wind through an open pass and strike from his unguarded side.

name: Impenetrable Smallface
description: Stand with feet set along the line of the foe's advance as along the rim of a high plateau.

name: Siltpelta
description: Walk the line that bars the foe's freedom of movement with the plate always turned to him.

name: Torrent Bucklerredge
description: Rap the foe's blade from the side as a crosswind knocks a traveler from the ridge.

name: Nudgescourge
description: Chop the rim down on the foe's wrist like a ridge dropping to the plain.

name: Aegis Centergrip
description: Draw in the plate as if a sudden drop had opened under the foe's attack.

name: Umbo Mettle
description: Harden the qi along the rim like stone so the edge can take the sharpest cut.

name: Webbing Parry
description: Bring the rim down over the foe's blade and pin it to the ground at the edge of his stance.

name: Targewrath
description: Rake the rim across the foe's front on a gust that carries it past his guard.

name: Gust Knucklegrip
description: Parry and return the plate to centre on the same breath of wind.

name: Aegis Roundface
description: Stretch qi along the whole rim to cover a wide arc with no gap between the covered and the open.

name: Gust Tuckin
description: Drive the dome into the foe's chest with the weight of a rockfall behind the arm.

name: Targeglare
description: Flash across the span of the foe's reach as if leaping a ridge and land with the rim at his guard.

name: Unrelenting Lightrim
description: Hold the plate in the open with nothing behind it but the body and the will to stand.

name: Murktarge
description: Turn the rim to the foe's blade and make the open ground a field of one clear line.

name: Silt Snapblock
description: Step wide under the open sky with the plate leading and no fear of the flank.

name: Peltarespite
description: Let qi widen the sight across the plateau so each foe's approach is read before it starts.

name: Devastating Dab
description: Strike with the rim open-handed so the whole plate turns its edge into the foe.

name: Unbowed Bucklerredge
description: Clear the guard of every brace and let the shifting qi alone hold it.

name: Unbudging Centergrip
description: Spread a vast screen of qi from the plate across open ground to hold off a charge.

name: Rumble Armstrap
description: Run at the foe with the plate leading and strike with the full length of the stride behind the dome.

name: Torrential Hour Armstrap
description: Flash from far across open ground to the foe's side with the plate already raised to strike.

name: Facet Smallface
description: Keep the plate on a fixed bearing toward the foe whatever his feet may do.

name: Mightumbo
description: Turn the feet to bring the plate back onto the bearing after each exchange.

name: Equipoise Edgeplate
description: Rap the foe's blade with the rim at the instant a gust lifts his guard.

name: Peltawrath
description: Jab along the bearing in a straight line the foe cannot escape by circling.

name: Targemettle
description: Brace the plate against a heavy blow as a tall tree braces against a gale.

name: Inexorable Umbo
description: Hold qi along the bearing so the plate resists every effort to push it off line.

name: Rumble Punchblock
description: Drive qi along the bearing from the heel through the dome in a single push.

name: Hoarfrost Snapblock
description: Hook the rim on the blade and haul along the bearing until the foe is pulled off his feet.

name: Equipoise Roundface
description: Correct the plate's angle in the instant a cut curves toward the flank.

name: Hoarfrost Knucklegrip
description: Throw a gale of qi forward along the bearing to turn aside a mass of blows.

name: Obdurate Punchboss
description: Catch a blow on the held bearing and return it along the same line to its source.

name: Dab Havoc
description: Smash through the foe's defence with the full weight of a gale along the bearing.

name: Nova Armstrap
description: Flash along the bearing in a straight line and arrive with the dome already in motion.

name: Aegis Edgeplate
description: Stand loose with the plate held where the wind can pass round it and leave no drag.

name: Siltumbo
description: Step into the lee of the foe's cut where the wind of the blow is least.

name: Chime Armstrap
description: Let the blade slip past the plate on its own wind and turn it on the way.

name: Iron Tuckin
description: Flick the rim along the foe's face guard in a quick light cut.

name: Hoarfrost Bucklerredge
description: Keep the plate so light that it moves with the foe's blade and catches it softly.

name: Peltamettle
description: Let qi flow around the plate as the wind flows round a rock and not against it.

name: Unsparing Punchblock
description: Strike with a gust of qi from the dome that reaches the foe a breath before the plate.

name: Hoarfrost Nudge
description: Wrap the rim and a coil of qi around the foe's blade and draw it from his grip.

name: Flintlike Lightrim
description: Open the qi in a wide wind from the plate that turns away blows and thrown blades from every side.

name: Glinttarge
description: Take a heavy blow on the plate as wind takes a sail and hurl its force back at the foe.

name: Flashing Dab
description: Pass the foe in a flash with no gust or sound and strike from his blind side.

name: Centergrip Mettle
description: Keep the plate on the foe's blade line as an oath is kept in the face of pain.

name: Peltaspine
description: Meet the blade with the rim and refuse to give it any ground.

name: Mightdab
description: Take one firm step forward on each parry as a pledge repaid in kind.

name: Snapblock Scourge
description: Rap the rim again and again on the same spot of the foe's guard until it yields.

name: Impervious Roundface
description: Fix qi in the rim so that it cannot be pushed from line by any blow.

name: Thorn Knucklegrip
description: Bind the foe's blade with the rim and keep it there as long as the oath is held.

name: Brutalizing Parry
description: Return every blow the plate has taken in one strike of the dome.

name: Unrelenting Punchboss
description: Hold a screen of qi at the rim that does not fail while the holder stands.

name: Veritytarge
description: Turn a charge on the rim and return it to the one who swore to break the line.

name: Glint Umbo
description: Flash into the gap an ally leaves and take the blow meant for him on the plate.

name: Aegis Smallface
description: Stand as the wind stands on the coast with the plate ready and the weight easy.

name: Siltdab
description: Step with the foe's attack and move on past it at the speed of a following wind.

name: Murk Armstrap
description: Rap the foe's blade sideways with a hard gust-quick flick of the wrist.

name: Rumbleumbo
description: Cut with the rim on the return of a turn so the stroke comes from behind the guard.

name: Thorn Lightrim
description: Lean the whole body behind the plate into a blow and let it slide away.

name: Targenerve
description: Keep qi blowing steadily from the plate so no blow can be driven home through it.

name: Ponderous Parry
description: Hook the rim on the blade and haul with a long wind of qi until the foe is drawn off line.

name: Parry Wrath
description: Punch the dome on a long wind of qi that carries the foe back several paces.

name: Torrent Lightrim
description: Veer the plate across a cut like a wind changing quarter and throw the blade out of line.

name: Facet Bucklerredge
description: Push a long screen of qi along the plate's front to cover the holder and a column behind him.

name: Eviscerating Tuckin
description: Sweep the plate round with a front of qi that strikes all foes within its reach.

name: Meteoric Nova Edgeplate
description: Flash far down the line of the wind and return with the plate at the back of the foe's guard.
